head: codex/79-bind-safe-deferred-targets
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Permit bind-safe deferred Rust targets
body:
Closes #79

## Summary
- limits missing Rust source and test deferrals to initialized pre-bind admission
- requires exact ownership and deliverables, a same-crate exact nextest target, `--no-tests=fail`, strict fail-closed policy, and an explicit temporary `#[path]` harness declaration
- rejects path-shaped validator deliverables outside issue ownership and ignores narrative deliverables as filesystem targets
- models the live #5866/#5871/#5872 prose/null-deferral state, proves it blocks, applies the required typed normalization, and proves doctor/bind succeeds

## Validation
- typed focused Gate 2 validation: 5 passed
- typed strict Clippy with warnings denied: PASS
- C-SDLC v2 library tests: 55 passed
- typed doctor at reviewed phase: PASS, no findings
- exact-head independent re-review: PASS at c1997952884fc509338dfd9b0116353fc16d7bd2

## Review findings resolved
- P1: fixture now begins from the exact live child preparation shape and proves the typed normalization handoff
- P2: unowned path-like validator deliverables now fail explicitly

## Boundary
- no Distributed Guardian product implementation or shared production module registration
- live child-owned STP/VPP records still require their demonstrated typed normalization before bind
- ready PR only; no merge authorization
